title: Ground rent cap faces implementation challenges
summary:
The UK government's planned cap on ground rents at £250 annually is set to affect approximately 3.8 million residential leasehold properties in England and Wales, with implementation expected in late 2028.

title: Cottage buyer interest falls 32% since 2023
summary:
Buyer interest in English countryside cottages has declined by 32% since the start of 2023, according to new data from property portal Zoopla. The average cottage price currently stands at £321,641, representing a 0.3% decline compared to August 2025.

title: Rental void periods decline to 21 days after legislation
summary:
Rental void periods across England have decreased to an average of 21 days in June, down from 24 days in May when the Renters' Rights Act came into force. The reduction suggests landlords are adjusting to new legislative requirements, though voids remain longer than the previous year.

title: New-build developers resist price cuts despite sales slowdown
summary:
Housebuilders are maintaining asking prices despite around one in eight new-build properties remaining unsold after six months on the market, according to analysis by specialist lender Octane Capital. The data shows that developers are prioritising profitability over sales velocity, with only 14.5% of properties seeing price reductions.

title: Student lettings firm appoints COO amid expansion
summary:
Student lettings agency Loc8me has appointed Wesley Brown as Chief Operating Officer as the company seeks to integrate recent acquisitions and support continued expansion across the UK. The business now manages approximately 10,000 student bedrooms across 19 university cities.

title: Off-market property platform launches with buyer verification
summary:
A new platform for off-market property transactions has launched in the UK, offering sellers the ability to list properties privately whilst maintaining competitive buyer interest through a verification system. Off-Market Keys connects verified buyers with properties not publicly advertised, with both parties paying a 0.1% fee when offers are accepted.

title: Letting agents gain automated Form 4A workflow tool
summary:
Street.co.uk has integrated the government's official Form 4A into its rent review workflow, allowing letting agents to generate, sign and serve mandatory rent increase notices within their existing platform. The integration addresses administrative requirements introduced by the Renters' Rights Act, which mandates that landlords and letting agents use the official Form 4A when proposing rent increases on periodic tenancies.

title: Colchester estate agency rebrands as self-employed model
summary:
A Colchester-based estate agency has rebranded and transitioned to a self-employed agent model, operating through the eXp platform's Team structure. Gyles & Rose, incorporated in 2020, has changed its name to the Naked Collective, trading as NAKED agents.

title: London Mayor allocates £400k for rental enforcement
summary:
The Mayor of London has announced £400,000 in funding to support enforcement of the Renters Rights Act, with resources directed towards training enforcement officers and providing tenant support services across the capital. The funding package will support the training of newly recruited enforcement officers in London boroughs.
